description: Visualize the hidden dimensions of your data with DataCube 3D. DataCube 3D is a high-performance custom visual designed for Power BI users who need to go beyond 2D charts. Whether you are analyzing sales performance, scientific data, or complex business metrics, DataCube 3D allows you to plot data across three axes simultaneously, revealing patterns that traditional scatter charts might miss. Key Features: True 3D Visualization: Map your data to X, Y, and Z axes to create a spatial representation of your metrics. Add hierarchies for drilling down. Intuitive Interaction: Rotate the cube 360 degrees using your mouse to view data from any angle. Zoom in to inspect clusters or zoom out for a high-level overview. Fully Integrated: Supports Power BI cross-filtering and tooltips. Clicking on other visuals will filter the DataCube in real-time. Customizable Markers: Adjust the size and color of data points based on your measures. Performance Optimized: Built to handle large datasets smoothly within the Power BI sandbox. Ideal Use Cases: Sales & Marketing: Compare Profit (X), Revenue (Y), and Quantity (Z) across different regions. Finance: Analyze Risk vs. Return vs. Time. Operations: Monitor machine performance across temperature, pressure, and vibration metrics. Open Source & Community Driven: This project is completely free, non-commercial, and open source.
